Treatment summary
Patient presented following a collision sustained while turning left, when the vehicle
was struck from the side. Complaints centered on neck and low back pain with associated
stiffness and muscle tightness. The mechanism of impact and the forces involved are
consistent with the soft tissue injuries reported. Over the course of eleevn visits,
treatmnet consisted of manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching
instruction, and followed a typical progression. Care was gradually reduced in
frequency as symptoms improved and range of motion returned. On examination,
paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical rotation were noted and support the
reported injury. Other neurological and orthopedic screening tests were within normal
limits. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment involving these same body
regions. Note that two similar billing entries dated the same day are currently under
review for accuracy and are not yet resolved.

  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
